cases.question: Which reporting periods does Ola identify as having operating cash outflows and losses?
cases.quote: activities in the three-months period ended June 30, 2023 and Fiscals 2023, 2022 and 2021 as shown below:

cases.question: Why might Ola's product expansion and international growth plans put pressure on profitability?
cases.quote: our sales footprint across international automotive markets, could result in an increase in our operating costs.

cases.question: Has Swiggy disclosed a history of losses despite growing revenue?
cases.quote: losses in each year since our incorporation and had negative cash flows from operating activities.

cases.question: Which categories of spending does Swiggy say it incurred to support growth?
cases.quote: expenses to increase our user base and enhance our brand; delivery and related costs to support our delivery facilitation

cases.question: How did Hyundai respond to semiconductor shortages, and what risk remains?
cases.quote: chips from alternate suppliers on a short-term basis by paying a higher price

cases.question: What royalty does Hyundai pay its parent, and how could termination affect production?
cases.quote: equal to 3.5% of our sales revenue

cases.question: What risk does Ola disclose about suppliers keeping pace as operations scale?
cases.quote: There can be no assurance that our existing suppliers will be able to provide adequate materials and EV components

cases.question: Which food-safety approvals does Swiggy say it must obtain and maintain?
cases.quote: licences issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
